parts.name: Regulation S-X
parts.blurb: Form and content of financial statements. Article rules are cited as Rule 1-01, Rule 3-05, and so on.

parts.name: Regulation Crowdfunding
parts.blurb: The exemption for crowdfunding offerings under Securities Act § 4(a)(6), including Rules 100 through 503.

parts.name: Regulation S-K
parts.blurb: Non-financial disclosure. Sections are Items (Item 101, Item 303, Item 402).

parts.name: Securities Act rules
parts.blurb: General rules under the Securities Act of 1933, including Regulation D, Rule 144, Regulation S, and the registration-statement rules.

parts.name: Regulation S-T
parts.blurb: EDGAR filing rules: electronic submission, hours, and the formatting requirements that apply to almost every form.

parts.name: Securities Act forms
parts.blurb: Forms prescribed under the Securities Act. The form pages under Forms restate what each form is for and link here for the Code section.

parts.name: Exchange Act rules
parts.blurb: General rules under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, including Rule 10b-5, Regulation 14A, and Regulation 13D-G.

parts.name: Regulation FD
parts.blurb: Selective disclosure. Rule 100 is the operative duty. Form 8-K Item 7.01 is the usual way to make the public disclosure.

parts.name: Regulation G
parts.blurb: Non-GAAP financial measures in public disclosures. Item 10(e) of Regulation S-K is the companion rule for filed documents.

parts.name: Regulation BTR
parts.blurb: Blackout trading restriction. Directors and executive officers are barred from certain transactions during a 401(k) blackout. Form 8-K Item 5.04 is the notice.

parts.name: Exchange Act forms
parts.blurb: Forms prescribed under the Exchange Act, including Forms 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K.
